items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: and it was Tommy Fulford, Beverly, and myself

ctx.x: A wonderful guy. And we do this date, so we go back to Boston and in a few days all the musicians received a check, and it was Tommy Fulford, Beverly, and myself, and (Inaudible) So I said receive a check "Where's my check." He said, "You don't get a check." I said, "Listen, you're taking it out of my salary if you're talking about the drums. It has nothing to do with the recording date. You're not supposed to take my recording date. You're supposed to take the money out --,"
